description: Sets up a sending and receiving address on a name inside the customer's own domain, so mail leaves from their own brand and their clients' replies arrive back in Booth Studio rather than a separate inbox.
variableDescription: %dkim%: the DKIM public key minted for this host. %bounces%: the MX host that collects bounce notifications. %returnpath%: the return-path CNAME target. %inbound%: the MX host that receives the customer's mail. All three are minted per host by the mail platform and cannot be pre-filled.
